editorial:
When a devoted dad is left home alone for the weekend, two stranded young women knock on his door asking for help. What starts as a kind gesture quickly turns into a dangerous seduction and a deadly game of cat and mouse. The movie leans hard into tension and uncomfortable moments, making you feel like you are right there in the house with him. It is the kind of thriller that keeps you on edge, wondering how far things will go and whether he can escape the trap.

Keanu Reeves carries the film with a raw, emotional performance that makes his character feel real and relatable. The two young women are unsettling and unpredictable, which adds to the suspense. The pacing is tight and the tension builds steadily, though some scenes feel a bit over the top. If you enjoy tense home-invasion thrillers with a dark twist, this one is worth your time. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the two women reveal they have done this to other men before and plan to frame him for everything. They destroy his home, tie him up, and leave him to take the blame. The twist is that they are not random strangers but calculated predators who target married men. The movie ends with them walking away free, leaving him broken and trapped in the wreckage of his life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves tense home-invasion thrillers with a dark twist.
